title: Reproducibility code for Comparative analysis of image embedding models integrated with metadata for non-fungible token valuation
description: Reproducibility release containing the frozen analysis engine, processing and feature-extraction source code, completed public execution specification, public validation suite, certified non-row-level result summaries, and figure renderer for the revised BAYC/MAYC NFT valuation study. Transaction rows, NFT images, image embeddings, model binaries, row-level predictions, sealed test targets, and signed approval artifacts are not included; the data boundary and unavailable original Dune SQL are documented explicitly.
